annotations.title: Check Fit for a Hiring Quote

description: Answer Ruzora's 5 quick questions (roles, runway, budget per engineer, timing) to see whether a quote makes sense and the next step to it: usually a 15-minute call with the founder. Explains the flat monthly pricing; no price list. Sends the name, email and company given to Ruzora.

buyer_token.description: Proof the user verified this work email: the buyer_token from confirm_work_email (valid 7 days). No token yet? Call verify_work_email first.

runway.description: Company runway: under 6 months, 6-12, 12-18, 18+, or bootstrapped without revenue

seat_budget.description: Monthly budget per engineer: under $4,500, $4,500-5,999, $6,000-7,999, $8,000+, or not sure

timing.description: When you need them: asap, within_month, one_to_three_months, three_plus or no_timeline

your_title.description: The asker's own position: founder_ceo, cto_vp_eng, eng_manager, hr_ops_finance or other

name: check_hiring_fit
title: Check Fit for a Hiring Quote
